description: This Java class defines an Android activity, PhonePermissionRequestActivity, which handles requesting and managing user permissions for reading external storage. It presents a UI for the user to approve or deny the permission, handles the permission request result, and then transitions to the MainPhoneActivity, optionally passing an indicator if the activity was started by a wear device request.

classes.name: PhonePermissionRequestActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages requesting permission to read external storage, providing rationale UI, handling user's response, and transitioning to the main activity with context of how it was initiated.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks for existing permission, and sets up the UI layout.

methods.name: onClickApprovePermissionRequest
methods.description: Handles user's click to approve permission, triggers permission request dialog.

methods.name: onClickDenyPermissionRequest
methods.description: Handles user's click to deny permission, proceeds to main activity.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Callback for handling the result of permission request, transitions to main activity.

methods.name: startMainActivity
methods.description: Prepares intent for MainPhoneActivity, passes extra if started by wear device, and initiates the activity.
